name: Kasbah of Algiers
description: The Kasbah is the old hillside medina of Algiers, Algeria's capital, tumbling down steeply to the Mediterranean. Founded by the Zirids in 944, it is a dense maze of narrow lanes, old mosques, Ottoman-style palaces and the remains of a citadel. It later became a stronghold of independence fighters in the Algerian War, and its tight-knit community still lives within its walls.
